bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; establishing a speed limit on a segment of Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 in the city of Victoria; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.14, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.14, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 5k.+]

[+Speed limit on Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 in the city of Victoria.+]

[+Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in this section, the speed limit on Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 between its intersection with Carver County State-Aid Highway 10 and Carver County State-Aid Highway 11 is 35 miles per hour. The commissioner must erect appropriate signs displaying the speed limit. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; establishing a speed limit on a segment of Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 in the city of Victoria; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.14, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.14, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5k.

Speed limit on Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 in the city of Victoria.

Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in this section, the speed limit on Carver County State-Aid Highway 43 between its intersection with Carver County State-Aid Highway 10 and Carver County State-Aid Highway 11 is 35 miles per hour. The commissioner must erect appropriate signs displaying the speed limit.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
